notes: 2026-10-20T01:28:11.780Z: Completed 88 public source-page checks: VesselFinder readable for 44/44 vessels; MarineTraffic blocked with HTTP 403 for 44/44. No blocked-source voyage data imported; previous valid values retained.

Public pages were opened and compared separately with current backend AIS records. Search snippets were not imported as current observations. Page caching is possible; consultation time is not signal time.

New destination references: Glovis Superior — Ulsan, South Korea; Glovis Sunrise — Hambantota, Sri Lanka; Glovis Cosmos — Manta, Ecuador; Sobaek Explorer — Dongying, China. Glovis Comet now reports arrival at Constanta Anchorage, Romania, not an ETA for a future arrival.

Ulsan court reference is preliminary: Civil Execution Act Article 278 was verified, but exact local territorial competence was not. Colombo reference is preliminary and retained with its previous date because the official FAQ was unavailable. Civil arrest jurisdiction for Constanta Anchorage, Manta and Dongying remains unverified.
43 source IMO/MMSI pairs match backend identities. VL Pioneer retains its documented conflicting MMSI records and no AIS identity or position was accepted.

No absolute source signal timestamp or coordinates were exposed by these public pages. Relative ages are quoted as displayed and yearless ETAs are not assigned a year or timezone. Supplemental references never overwrite timestamped AIS data.
